en: A one-line hook shown on the storefront card.
The door gives, and the room opens ahead of you.
Nothing I have a word for.
Nothing tried to eat us today. Sleep.
Step light. That floor is thinner than it looks.
The walls are moving. Slowly, but they are moving.
They are not breathing. That is you they are leaning towards.
Fill your chest at the door and do not let it go until the far side.
The boards give a little under your weight, and go on giving.
The walls are moving. Slowly, but they are moving.
They lean when you lean. It is not the air moving them.
It wants the air you give it. Take one breath at the door and do not give it another.
